svg.title: Normal Vectors Go Feral
svg.desc: Twenty-four knotted splines emit thousands of normal vectors. High-frequency magnitude functions reach 190 before a 2.65 length multiplier; negative lobes alternately disappear or wrap modulo 97, tearing the local tangent geometry into a field of long discontinuous needles. Native toolbar flow: cross-normal spline echoes → three oblique spline planes, with a luminance-preserving monochrome palette.
